typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Timestamp as string,
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_12 RackTemp} as string,
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_11 RackTemp} as string,
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_11 RackHum} as string,
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_12 RackHum} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource select(mapColumn(
		Timestamp = Timestamp,
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_12 RackTemp} = {DEN3 Sensors_1_12 RackTemp},
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_11 RackTemp} = {DEN3 Sensors_1_11 RackTemp},
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_11 RackHum} = {DEN3 Sensors_1_11 RackHum},
		{DEN3 Sensors_1_12 RackHum} = {DEN3 Sensors_1_12 RackHum}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
